leadStory: Andoni Iraola keeps a small senior group working at the AXA through the three-week international break rather than treating it as a holiday, and builds the fortnight around two returns to full group training: Giovanni Leoni, a year on from his ACL, and Federico Chiesa, aiming to be back on the grass by the end of the month.
note: No Track 2 request this edition. The lead is a training-ground and international-break story, players scattering to national sides and two long-term absentees rejoining group work, which does not resolve into a single strong still, and the skill caps queueing at one genuinely visual moment per edition. Antigravity should take no action. If a plate is wanted for a future edition, the standing candidate remains Jeremy Jacquet, 21, the best player on the field on the day France called him up for the first time.
